key.name: enable-left-speaker
key.description: Renders the left-channel 8-bit triangular spectrum visualizer in the bottom-left screen corner.

key.name: enable-right-speaker
key.description: Renders the right-channel 8-bit triangular spectrum visualizer in the bottom-right screen corner.

key.name: corner-size
key.description: Width and height of each bottom-corner right-triangle speaker widget in pixels.

key.name: corner-margin
key.description: Distance in pixels from the bottom and side screen edges (default 6 px matching Reef).

key.name: column-count
key.summary: Number of 8-bit frequency columns per speaker (4–12)
key.description: Number of stepped frequency columns inside each triangular corner speaker.

key.name: show-peak-caps
key.description: Renders a bright 8-bit peak-hold brick at the top of each column that decays smoothly.

key.name: idle-hide
key.summary: Auto-fade speakers when audio is silent
key.description: Dims or hides the corner speakers when no audio is playing.

key.name: sensitivity
key.description: Scales incoming Left/Right dB levels to make the 8-bit bricks more or less reactive.

key.name: color-mode
key.description: 'suite-accent' uses the synced Studio 2201 accent color; 'arcade-vu' uses classic Emerald -> Amber -> Coral VU tiers.

key.name: background-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the corner speaker background from 0 (transparent) to 100 (solid), default 80% matching Reef.

key.name: brick-opacity
key.description: Transparency of the lit 8-bit frequency bricks and peak-hold caps.

key.name: show-border
key.summary: Show accent border ring around corner speakers
key.description: When true, draws a high-contrast border ring around the corner speakers matching Kelp and Reef.

key.name: border-width
key.description: Thickness of the corner speaker border ring in CSS pixels (default 2 px matching Kelp and Reef).

key.name: border-radius
key.description: Corner rounding of the outer right-angle corner in CSS pixels (default 16 px matching Reef).

key.name: border-color-rgba
key.summary: Accent border and 8-bit brick color (RGBA or hex)
key.description: CSS RGB/RGBA color string for the speaker border ring and bricks (default Coral Red matching Kelp and Reef).

key.name: scroll-volume
key.summary: Scroll wheel on corner speakers adjusts system volume
key.description: Scrolling up or down on either corner triangle raises or lowers master output volume.

key.name: click-action
key.description: Action when left-clicking inside a corner triangle: 'play-pause', 'mute', or 'none'.
